layeredNetworkContract.processTopology: before attacker input, supervisor forks one launcher; launcher enters and proves a distinct private user and network namespace; only then supervisor installs monotonic IP-deny seccomp and reads request; ingest descends from supervisor, worker descends only from private launcher
layeredNetworkContract.launcherAttestation: launcher passes userns and netns FDs; both fstatfs NSFS_MAGIC; NS_GET_NSTYPE proves CLONE_NEWUSER and CLONE_NEWNET; NS_GET_USERNS owner dev/inode equals launcher userns; both differ from preopened host namespaces; SCM_CREDENTIALS exact; initial namespace capabilities empty
layeredNetworkContract.launcherDescriptorAllowlist: fd0 /dev/null; fd1 and fd2 bounded supervisor diagnostic pipes or /dev/null; one AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET control FD; one sync barrier; verified userns and netns FDs; accepted socket and every duplicate, pack, object, profile, candidate and all other FDs closed
layeredNetworkContract.launcherInputs: only supervisor-verified profile and snapshot FDs plus fixed closed execution descriptor; no raw request, pack, receipt or product decision
layeredNetworkContract.supervisorAndIngestSeccomp: all transport control and attestation sockets precreated and identity-frozen; supervisor then denies socket socketpair connect bind listen sendto sendmmsg and all addressed-send APIs; sendmsg recvmsg only on non-closeable non-duplicable exact AF_UNIX control or attestation FDs, accepted transport uses read write; prove no IP FD and test close plus fd-reuse; ingest has stricter no-socket-API filter and only pipes or memfd
layeredNetworkContract.workerNamespace: descendant of preverified launcher in fresh private network namespace with loopback only; never a descendant of supervisor IP-deny filter
layeredNetworkContract.workerSeccomp: AF_INET and AF_INET6 allowed only inside private namespace; other families remain denied
layeredNetworkContract.proofRule: systemd IP policy, role seccomp and private namespace must pass together; no single layer is sufficient

credentialAttestationContract.helperCarrier: fresh AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET; parent SO_PASSCRED; one recvmsg with SCM_CREDENTIALS and SCM_RIGHTS; pipe and helper SO_PEERCRED forbidden
credentialAttestationContract.outerHostIdentity: per-message kernel SCM_CREDENTIALS PID UID GID after credential drop
credentialAttestationContract.innerNamespaceIdentity: kernel procfs task-directory and status FDs transferred by SCM_RIGHTS after credential drop and NO_NEW_PRIVS
credentialAttestationContract.dropOrder: setgroups([]), setresgid, setresuid, PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, attest, parent verify, release exec barrier
credentialAttestationContract.parentChecks: expected child relation, one message, closed schema, exact SCM credentials; fstatfs PROC_SUPER_MAGIC on both FDs; reopen status from received task dirfd with openat2 beneath no-symlink no-magiclink and compare dev/inode; parse kernel Uid Gid Groups capabilities NoNewPrivs Pid Tgid NSpid; outer NSpid equals SCM PID; no replay or PID replacement

capabilityContract.bwrapContract: unprivileged user namespace only; fresh mapped child user namespace may hold namespaced CAP_SYS_ADMIN solely during trusted bootstrap; all capability sets zero before untrusted exec; unavailable means ENVIRONMENT_PREREQUISITE_UNAVAILABLE

disconnectCancellationContract.architecture: root supervisor is the sole nonblocking lifecycle event loop; every heavy stage runs in a pidfd/process-group supervised child; no separate undefined privileged watchdog
disconnectCancellationContract.startsAfter: launcher private-net proof completes before request read; peer cancellation monitoring becomes authenticated after full request authentication
supervisorForbiddenOperations: blocking object decompress parse or materialization
disconnectCancellationContract.expectedRequestHalfClose: exact frame followed by client SHUT_WR produces read EOF or POLLRDHUP and is recorded but never treated as cancellation
disconnectCancellationContract.disconnectAction: terminate current stage and launcher, exit supervisor and rely on KillMode=control-group to clear descendants and runtime state
disconnectCancellationContract.successOrder: all stage and worker exit; launcher exit; object work tmp and runtime state cleanup verified; cgroup contains only supervisor; typed receipt; response EOF; supervisor exit
disconnectCancellationContract.installedBarrier: root-owned separate inherited FD only when exact installed broker and test identities plus --installed-acceptance non-production invocation match; ordinary request cannot enable or choose a barrier
